title: release-notes prose
description: The ONLY output of the polish agent. Prose strings that fill the deterministic page template. The agent writes no headings, tables, banners, @handles, hearts or PR links — those are rendered from data.json.

theme.description: 2-6 words naming what THIS release is about, e.g. 'First stable v4 release'. Rendered bold in the banner. No trailing punctuation.

highlights_headline.description: ONE sentence, <=20 WORDS: the single most important thing about the complete release line across previews, RCs, and stable.

highlights_body.description: Optional cumulative release-line summary. <=60 WORDS. Aim for 40-60 words on feature releases and 20-40 on servicing releases, without PR links, handles, or a changelog dump.

breaking.description: One entry per behavioural or signature breaking change a consumer must act on. Empty array renders 'None in this release.' Titles/bodies only — PR links are added from prs[].

categories.description: Curated product-facing sections. Security content comes only from the maintainer notes sidecar; scripts do not infer it. Each bullet merges related PRs into one theme; the template renders links and community credit.

contributor_summaries.description: One entry per login in data.contributors (roster). Value = one line summarising that person's contributions in prose, e.g. 'Variable fonts, singleton lifecycle rework and the SKPath finalizer fix'. The template adds the @handle and PR links.

release_summaries.description: Evergreen present-tense summaries keyed by every exact leading-v Preview, RC, and stable tag. Each describes only that tag's delta and is rendered on the website and available to the GitHub Release updater.

summary.description: Three or four timeless present-tense sentences suitable for an official GitHub Release introduction. Aim for 80-130 words; small servicing or no-change releases may use 20-80 words. Describe only the exact tag delta.

prs.description: The most relevant PRs grounding this summary. Every number must belong to the exact shipment delta.

harfbuzz_summary.description: 1-2 sentences summarising the HarfBuzz-specific changes in this release. Required when data.harfbuzz.prs is non-empty or data.harfbuzz.version differs from data.harfbuzz.previous_version; null/omit when neither changed or when data.harfbuzz is absent. The template adds the '## HarfBuzzSharp X.Y.Z' heading.
